item.title: Trump Says He’ll Raise Tariffs to 15 Percent After Supreme Court Ruling
item.description: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he wants a global tariff of 15%, up from 10% he had announced a day earlier after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down many of the far-reaching taxes on imports that he had imposed over the last year.
